run_generate_functions: run the generate_functions script to produce Python bindings from a Clang AST JSON dump of mujoco.h
build_mujoco_api_functions: build a Python FUNCTIONS mapping from Clang AST JSON and a C header file for MuJoCo API declarations
traverse_clang_ast: traverse a Clang AST JSON tree visiting each node with a custom visitor callback
create_mj_function_visitor: create an MjFunctionVisitor to extract MuJoCo function declarations with nullable params and doc comments from Clang AST nodes
summarize_generate_functions: summarize how generate_functions parses C function declarations into Python type-annotated function metadata
